caption:
16 years. Zero boxing golds. Then two in one day.

Lairenlakpam Ambekar Meetei (boys' 50kg) and Gunjan (girls' 48kg) won India's first-ever boxing golds at the Youth Olympic Games in Dakar on Thursday. Ambekar lost the first round on all five cards and came back to win a 3-2 split decision against Ireland. Gunjan swept Algeria 5-0, and is the first Indian woman to win Youth Olympic boxing gold.

India finish Dakar with 10 medals (2 gold, 3 silver, 5 bronze) from a 17-athlete squad: their second-best Youth Olympics, behind 13 at Buenos Aires 2018.

The other firsts: Dhinidhi Desinghu won two swimming bronzes, Shourya Ambure took 100m hurdles bronze, and Tanvi Patri, Khushbu Darjada and Taniya won silver. The Tribune reports 5 of the 9 medallists are Khelo India athletes.
